Application Data.NAME: Vintage Treasures Antiques
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Vintage Treasures Antiques specializes in the retail sale of carefully curated antique and collectible items, including furniture, art, jewelry, and vintage memorabilia. Our store focuses on providing customers with a unique shopping experience, featuring a diverse inventory sourced from local estates and auctions. We implement robust inventory control measures and maintain a secure environment with CCTV and alarm systems to prevent theft and ensure the safety of our valuable items. Additionally, we offer online sales through our e-commerce platform, complementing our brick-and-mortar operations while adhering to strict cybersecurity protocols. Our knowledgeable staff is trained in customer service and loss prevention techniques, fostering a welcoming atmosphere for both local and tourist customers.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, a theft occurred at our store, resulting in the loss of several high-value collectible items, amounting to approximately $1,200.00. The claim was processed, and we received reimbursement from our previous insurance carrier. The status of the loss is closed, and we have since implemented enhanced security measures, including additional CCTV coverage and employee training focused on loss prevention.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, 10 bolt safe, fire-resistant, up to 2 hours.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system with 24/7 monitoring, alarm system, and occasional security patrols.
